docs.title: SHARP — Smart Hostel Administration and Resource Platform
docs.text: SHARP is a centralized platform for managing hostel administration and resource-management workflows.

docs.title: Work Done
docs.text: Worked on the mess feedback feature for the SHARP Student Portal and Mess Manager Portal.

docs.title: Contributions
docs.text:
• Added a student form to submit feedback for a selected meal and category.
  • Added star ratings and written comments to feedback submissions.
  • Added a student-facing view of recent feedback.
  • Added a manager-facing feedback view to review submissions for the assigned mess.
  • Kept the reporter's identity out of the feedback data presented to mess managers.
  • Added filters and rating summaries to help managers review feedback.
  • Tested feedback submission, rating validation, mess scoping, and anonymity in manager responses.

docs.title: Outcome
docs.text: Students can submit categorized meal feedback, and mess managers can review feedback for their assigned mess without seeing the reporter's identity.

docs.title: Journal Entry 8 – Portal Expansion, Complaint Management & UI Cleanup
Work Done
docs.text: I expanded the SHARP prototype with a dedicated Mess Manager Portal, improved complaint handling, and made a series of interface and usability refinements across the portals.

docs.title: My Contributions
docs.text:
• Added a dedicated Mess Manager Portal and connected the manager role to portal navigation and the demo account switcher.
  • Added a Mess Manager registration path with manager details and assigned-mess selection.
  • Improved the student complaint form so issue categories match the selected complaint type.
  • Added a 72-hour service deadline to new complaints and server-side checks for overdue complaints.
  • Added one-time notifications to administrators when open complaints exceed the service deadline.
  • Added an Admin Portal complaint overview with open, overdue, and closed counts, complaint status, SLA information, and caretaker assignment or reassignment.
  • Restricted caretaker complaint queues to complaints assigned to that caretaker.
  • Added API-level tests for complaint submission, caretaker assignment, SLA escalation, and student confirmation of resolution.
  • Refined the room-allocation floor map by removing its status legend and changing availability and occupancy count text to black.
  • Simplified the student portal UI by removing an informational text box, shortening the closed-allotment message, and replacing the mess-rating dropdown with an interactive star selector.
  • Removed sidebar navigation icons across portals and role icons from the demo account list while keeping labels and navigation available.
  • Standardized registration button styling and fixed related UI inconsistencies.

docs.title: Testing
docs.text:
• Ran JavaScript syntax checks for the updated portal and server files.
  • Ran the complaint lifecycle and mess-feedback API tests successfully.

docs.title: Outcome
docs.text: The prototype now has a dedicated manager portal, clearer complaint oversight and escalation, and a more consistent, less cluttered interface across the portals.
